title: AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.scalarSourceFactor
statement: For a commutative ring Λ in Type(u+1), schemes S,Y,Y′, arrows a:Y′→Y, h:Y→S, h′:Y′→S with a≫h=h′, a Λ-module sheaf L on S, an abelian sheaf E on S and t:E→forget(L), construct the degree-zero scalar source factor single(h* t≫scalar pullback) followed by the inverse forgetting single comparison [def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Construct also the module and abelian source factors single(upperStarComp.hom) followed by the corresponding inverse pullback single comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition].
